paragraphs.text: Doran , the Siege Tower, is an immense black poplar treefolk from the plane of Lorwyn .

Doran is incredibly large and has acquired a wide array of magical knowledge during his travels across the plane. He seems to feel at home in many different settings, most likely a result of his far wanderings. It is thought that his wayfaring ways led to the collection of diverse magics that he combined into his unique magical style. Doran uses obscure shamanic magic to turn the natural durability of treefolk into their greatest advantage and was able to share this boon with his allies.

In his later years, Doran dwells in Shadowmoor as a twisted reflection of his old self. Burdened with knowledge and sapience beyond his Shadowmoor treefolk kin, he is voiceless and cursed to wander the darkness. His creaks echo through forests where no one dares approach him. He is afraid to step back into the light, unsure whether the knowledge and memories he has gained will remain across the boundary. He may be affected by the canker, a treefolk wasting disease.

The playtest name of Doran, the Siege Tower was " Gnarles Barkley ". The Mystery Booster 2 playtest card Narod, the Beige Flower is a parody of Doran, the Siege Tower . The character's name is a reversal of Doran's; its card name rhymes with his; its mechanic is a reversal of his; and it is "stickered" on top of a copy of his card.
